    # One numeric column = safest fallback
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if len(numeric_columns) == 1:
        return numeric_columns[0]

    return None


# =========================================================
# FIND DIMENSION COLUMN
# =========================================================

def _find_dimension_column(
    df,
    question,
    mentioned_values=None
):

    categorical_columns = _categorical_columns(df)

    if not categorical_columns:
        return None

    q = _normalize(question)

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Explicit column name
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    for column in categorical_columns:

        column_text = _normalize(column)

        variants = [
            column_text,
            column_text.replace("_", " "),
            column_text.replace("_", ""),
        ]

        if any(
            variant
            and variant in q
            for variant in variants
        ):
            return column

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Value-based detection
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if mentioned_values:

        for column in categorical_columns:

            values = (
                df[column]
                .dropna()
                .astype(str)
                .str.strip()
                .unique()
                .tolist()
            )

            normalized_values = {
                _normalize(value)
                for value in values
            }

            matches = 0

            for value in mentioned_values:

                if (
                    _normalize(value)
                    in normalized_values
                ):
                    matches += 1

            if matches >= 2:
                return column

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Common dimensions
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    dimension_words = [
        "department",
        "dept",
        "region",
        "area",
        "location",
        "city",
        "state",
        "country",
        "category",
        "segment",
        "product",
        "team",
        "division",
        "gender",
        "customer",
        "employee",
        "name",
    ]

    for column in categorical_columns:

        column_text = (
            _normalize(column)
            .replace("_", " ")
        )

        if any(
            word in column_text
            for word in dimension_words
        ):

            if any(
                word in q
                for word in dimension_words
            ):
                return column

    return None


# =========================================================
# FIND VALUES MENTIONED IN QUESTION
# =========================================================

def _mentioned_values(
    df,
    column,
    question
):

    question_text = _normalize(question)

    values = (
        df[column]
        .dropna()
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    matches = []

    for value in values:

        value_text = _normalize(value)

        if not value_text:
            continue

        pattern = (
            r"(?<!\w)"
            + re.escape(value_text)
            + r"(?!\w)"
        )

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            question_text
        )

        if match:

            matches.append(
                (
                    match.start(),
                    value
                )
            )

    matches.sort(
        key=lambda item: item[0]
    )

    result = []
    seen = set()

    for _, value in matches:

        key = _normalize(value)

        if key not in seen:

            seen.add(key)
            result.append(value)

    return result


# =========================================================
# CHART RENDERER
# =========================================================

def _render_chart(
    data,
    chart_type,
    title=None,
    dimension_col=None,
    metric_col=None
):
    """
    Central chart rendering function.

    Supported:
        bar
        line
        pie
        scatter
        histogram
    """

    if data is None or data.empty:
        return False

    if title:
        st.markdown(
            f"### 📊 {title}"
        )

    # =====================================================
    # BAR
    # =====================================================

    if chart_type == "bar":

        st.bar_chart(
            data,
            use_container_width=True
        )

        return True

    # =====================================================
    # LINE
    # =====================================================

    if chart_type == "line":

        st.line_chart(
            data,
            use_container_width=True
        )

        return True

    # =====================================================
    # SCATTER
    # =====================================================

    if chart_type == "scatter":

        try:

            import plotly.express as px

            if (
                dimension_col is None
                or metric_col is None
            ):
                return False

            plot_data = data.copy()

            fig = px.scatter(
                plot_data,
                x=dimension_col,
                y=metric_col,
                title=None,
            )

            fig.update_layout(
                margin=dict(
                    l=20,
                    r=20,
                    t=20,
                    b=20
                )
            )

            st.plotly_chart(
                fig,
                use_container_width=True
            )

            return True

        except Exception:

            # Graceful fallback
            st.scatter_chart(
                data,
                x=dimension_col,
                y=metric_col,
                use_container_width=True
            )

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # PIE
    # =====================================================

    if chart_type == "pie":

        try:

            import plotly.express as px

            if (
                dimension_col is None
                or metric_col is None
            ):
                return False

            plot_data = data.copy()

            fig = px.pie(
                plot_data,
                names=dimension_col,
                values=metric_col,
            )

            fig.update_layout(
                margin=dict(
                    l=20,
                    r=20,
                    t=20,
                    b=20
                )
            )

            st.plotly_chart(
                fig,
                use_container_width=True
            )

            return True

        except Exception:

            # If Plotly isn't installed,
            # use a bar chart instead.
            st.bar_chart(
                data.set_index(
                    dimension_col
                )[metric_col],
                use_container_width=True
            )

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # HISTOGRAM
    # =====================================================

    if chart_type == "histogram":

        try:

            import plotly.express as px

            plot_data = data.copy()

            fig = px.histogram(
                plot_data,
                x=metric_col,
                nbins=20,
            )

            fig.update_layout(
                margin=dict(
                    l=20,
                    r=20,
                    t=20,
                    b=20
                )
            )

            st.plotly_chart(
                fig,
                use_container_width=True
            )

            return True

        except Exception:

            # Fallback histogram using
            # pandas value counts.

            histogram = (
                data[metric_col]
                .dropna()
                .value_counts()
                .sort_index()
            )

            st.bar_chart(
                histogram,
                use_container_width=True
            )

            return True

    return False


# =========================================================
# INTELLIGENT CHART SELECTION
# =========================================================

def _choose_chart_type(
    question,
    dimension_col=None,
    metric_col=None,
    df=None
):
    """
    Decide the most appropriate chart based
    on the question and dataset structure.
    """

    q = _normalize(question)

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Distribution
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if _is_distribution_question(question):

        return "histogram"

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Relationship / correlation
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if _is_relationship_question(question):

        if (
            df is not None
            and len(_numeric_columns(df)) >= 2
        ):
            return "scatter"

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Time / trend
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if _is_time_question(question):

        return "line"

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Share / percentage
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if _is_share_question(question):

        return "pie"

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Comparison
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if _comparison_requested(question):

        return "bar"

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Highest / lowest / top
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if (
        _highest_requested(question)
        or _lowest_requested(question)
    ):

        return "bar"

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Grouped categorical analysis
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if (
        dimension_col is not None
        and metric_col is not None
    ):

        return "bar"

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Default
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    return "bar"

def _show_generic_comparison(
    df,
    question,
    dimension_col,
    metric_col
):

    values = _mentioned_values(
        df,
        dimension_col,
        question
    )

    if len(values) < 2:
        return False

    selected = values[:2]

    data = df.copy()

    data[metric_col] = _numeric(
        data,
        metric_col
    )

    data["__dimension__"] = (
        data[dimension_col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    data = data.dropna(
        subset=[
            metric_col
        ]
    )

    data = data[
        data["__dimension__"].isin(
            selected
        )
    ]

    if data.empty:
        return False

    q = _normalize(question)

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Aggregation
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "average" in q
        or "avg" in q
        or "mean" in q
    ):

        grouped = (
            data
            .groupby("__dimension__")[metric_col]
            .mean()
        )

        aggregation_label = "Average"

    elif (
        "total" in q
        or "sum" in q
    ):

        grouped = (
            data
            .groupby("__dimension__")[metric_col]
            .sum()
        )

        aggregation_label = "Total"

    else:

        # Default comparison = TOTAL
        grouped = (
            data
            .groupby("__dimension__")[metric_col]
            .sum()
        )

        aggregation_label = "Total"

    grouped = grouped.reindex(
        selected
    )

    if grouped.isna().any():
        return False

    first_value = float(
        grouped.iloc[0]
    )

    second_value = float(
        grouped.iloc[1]
    )

    difference = abs(
        first_value - second_value
    )

    first_name = selected[0]
    second_name = selected[1]

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Chart
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    chart_data = (
        grouped
        .rename(
            f"{aggregation_label} {metric_col}"
        )
    )

    _render_chart(
        chart_data,
        "bar",
        f"{first_name} vs {second_name} — "
        f"{aggregation_label} {metric_col}",
        dimension_col,
        metric_col
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Table
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    table = (
        grouped
        .rename(
            f"{aggregation_label} {metric_col}"
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    table.columns = [
        dimension_col,
        f"{aggregation_label} {metric_col}"
    ]

    st.dataframe(
        table,
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Difference
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    col1, col2 = st.columns(2)

    with col1:

        st.metric(
            "Difference",
            f"{difference:,.2f}"
        )

    with col2:

        if first_value > second_value:
            higher = first_name

        elif second_value > first_value:
            higher = second_name

        else:
            higher = "Equal"

        st.metric(
            "Higher",
            higher
        )

    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Explanation
    # -----------------------------------------------------

    if first_value > second_value:

        st.info(
            f"{first_name} has higher "
            f"{aggregation_label.lower()} "
            f"{metric_col} than "
            f"{second_name}."
        )

    elif second_value > first_value:

        st.info(
            f"{second_name} has higher "
            f"{aggregation_label.lower()} "
            f"{metric_col} than "
            f"{first_name}."
        )

    else:

        st.info(
            f"{first_name} and "
            f"{second_name} have equal "
            f"{aggregation_label.lower()} "
            f"{metric_col}."
        )

    return True

# =========================================================
# THRESHOLD ANALYSIS
# =========================================================

def _show_threshold(
    df,
    question,
    person_col,
    metric_col
):

    q = _normalize(question)

    patterns = [

        (
            r"(?:more than|greater than|above|over|exceeding)"
            r"\s*\$?\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)",
            ">"
        ),

        (
            r"(?:less than|below|under)"
            r"\s*\$?\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)",
            "<"
        ),

        (
            r"(?:at least|minimum of)"
            r"\s*\$?\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)",
            ">="
        ),

        (
            r"(?:at most|maximum of)"
            r"\s*\$?\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)",
            "<="
        ),
    ]

    operator = None
    threshold = None

    for pattern, op in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            q
        )

        if match:

            threshold = float(
                match.group(1)
                .replace(",", "")
            )

            operator = op

            break

    if operator is None:
        return False

    data = df[
        [
            person_col,
            metric_col
        ]
    ].copy()

    data[metric_col] = _numeric(
        data,
        metric_col
    )

    data = data.dropna(
        subset=[
            person_col,
            metric_col
        ]
    )

    if operator == ">":

        result = data[
            data[metric_col] > threshold
        ]

    elif operator == "<":

        result = data[
            data[metric_col] < threshold
        ]

    elif operator == ">=":

        result = data[
            data[metric_col] >= threshold
        ]

    else:

        result = data[
            data[metric_col] <= threshold
        ]

    result = result.sort_values(
        metric_col,
        ascending=False
    )

    st.markdown(
        f"### 📊 {metric_col} "
        f"{operator} "
        f"{threshold:,.0f}"
    )

    if result.empty:

        st.info(
            "No matching records were found."
        )

    else:

        st.dataframe(
            result,
            use_container_width=True,
            hide_index=True
        )

        chart_data = (
            result
            .set_index(person_col)[
                metric_col
            ]
        )

        _render_chart(
            chart_data,
            "bar"
        )

    return True

            include=[
                "datetime",
                "datetimetz"
            ]
        )
        .columns
        .tolist()
    )

    if datetime_columns:
        return datetime_columns[0]

    # Look for date-like column names
    candidates = [
        "date",
        "datetime",
        "timestamp",
        "month",
        "year",
        "time",
    ]

    for column in df.columns:

        column_text = _normalize(
            column
        )

        if any(
            candidate in column_text
            for candidate in candidates
        ):

            converted = pd.to_datetime(
                df[column],
                errors="coerce"
            )

            if converted.notna().sum() >= 2:
                return column

    return None

def _find_second_numeric_column(
    df,
    question,
    first_metric
):

    numeric_columns = _numeric_columns(
        df
    )

    remaining = [
        column
        for column in numeric_columns
        if column != first_metric
    ]

    if not remaining:
        return None

    q = _normalize(question)

    # Prefer a column explicitly mentioned
    for column in remaining:

        column_text = _normalize(
            column
        )

        if column_text in q:

            return column

        if (
            column_text.replace("_", " ")
            in q
        ):

            return column

    # Common pairs
    pairs = [
        (
            "salary",
            [
                "experience",
                "age",
                "performance"
            ]
        ),

        (
            "sales",
            [
                "profit",
                "quantity",
                "units"
            ]
        ),

        (
            "experience",
            [
                "salary",
                "performance",
                "age"
            ]
        ),
    ]

    first_text = _normalize(
        first_metric
    )

    for key, possible_columns in pairs:

        if key in first_text:

            for column in remaining:

                column_text = _normalize(
                    column
                )

                if any(
                    item in column_text
                    for item in possible_columns
                ):

                    return column

    return remaining[0]


def _show_scatter(
    df,

    metric_col
):

    second_metric = _find_second_numeric_column(
        df,

        [

            metric_col
        ]
    ].copy()

    data[second_metric] = _numeric(
        data,
        second_metric
    )

    data[metric_col] = _numeric(
        data,
        metric_col
    )

    data = data.dropna()

    if data.empty:
        return False

    try:

        import plotly.express as px

        fig = px.scatter(
            data,
            x=second_metric,
            y=metric_col,
        )

        fig.update_layout(
            title=(
                f"{metric_col} vs "
                f"{second_metric}"
            ),
            margin=dict(
                l=20,
                r=20,
                t=50,
                b=20
            )
        )

        st.plotly_chart(
            fig,
            use_container_width=True
        )

    except Exception:

            data,
            x=second_metric,
            y=metric_col,
            use_container_width=True
        )

    # Correlation

                [
                    second_metric,
                    metric_col
                ]
            ]
            .corr()
            .iloc[0, 1]
        )

        st.metric(
            "Correlation",
            f"{correlation:.2f}"
        )

    return True


# =========================================================
# PIE / SHARE
# =========================================================

def _show_share(
    df,
    question,
    dimension_col,
    metric_col
):

    data = df.copy()

    data[metric_col] = _numeric(
        data,
        metric_col
    )

    data = data.dropna(
        subset=[
            dimension_col,
            metric_col
        ]
    )

    if data.empty:
        return False

    grouped = (
        data
        .groupby(dimension_col)[metric_col]
        .sum()
        .sort_values(
            ascending=False
        )
        .head(15)
    )

    if grouped.empty:
        return False

    chart_data = (
        grouped
        .reset_index()
    )

    _render_chart(
        chart_data,
        "pie",
        f"{metric_col} Share by {dimension_col}",
        dimension_col,
        metric_col
    )

    # Percentage table
    total = grouped.sum()

    table = (
        grouped
        .rename("Value")
        .reset_index()
    )

    table["Percentage"] = (
        table["Value"]
        / total
        * 100
    )

    table["Percentage"] = (
        table["Percentage"]
        .round(2)
    )

    st.dataframe(
        table,
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True
    )

    return True


# =========================================================
# GENERIC FALLBACK
# =========================================================

def _generic_visualization(
    df,
    question
):

    numeric_columns = _numeric_columns(
        df
    )

    categorical_columns = _categorical_columns(
        df
    )

    if (
        not numeric_columns
        or not categorical_columns
    ):
        return False

    metric = _find_metric_column(
        df,
        question
    )

    if metric is None:
        metric = numeric_columns[0]

    dimension = _find_dimension_column(
        df,
        question
    )

    if dimension is None:
        dimension = categorical_columns[0]

    if _is_distribution_question(
        question
    ):

        return _show_histogram(
            df,
            question,
            metric
        )

    if _is_relationship_question(
        question
    ):

        return _show_scatter(
            df,
            question,
            metric
        )

    if _is_time_question(
        question
    ):

        if _show_time_series(
            df,
            question,
            metric
        ):
            return True

    if _is_share_question(
        question
    ):

        return _show_share(
            df,
            question,
            dimension,
            metric
        )

    if _average_requested(
        question
    ):

        return _show_grouped(
            df,
            dimension,
            metric,
            "mean",
            f"Average {metric} by {dimension}",
            question
        )

    if _total_requested(
        question
    ):

        return _show_grouped(
            df,
            dimension,
            metric,
            "sum",
            f"Total {metric} by {dimension}",
            question
        )

    return False


# =========================================================
# MAIN VISUALIZATION ENGINE
# =========================================================

def generate_visual_analysis(
    df,
    question=None
):
    """
    Generic AI-style visualization engine.

    Supported chart types:

    - Bar
    - Line
    - Pie
    - Scatter
    - Histogram

    Supported analysis:

    - Category comparison
    - Metric comparison
    - Average
    - Total
    - Highest
    - Lowest
    - Top N
    - Threshold
    - Distribution
    - Trend
    - Share
    - Correlation
    - Grouped analysis

    Returns:

        True
            Visualization created.

        False
            No suitable visualization found.
    """

    # =====================================================
    # VALIDATION
    # =====================================================

    if (
        df is None
        or df.empty
        or not question
    ):

        return False

    data = _clean_columns(
        df
    )

    question = str(
        question
    ).strip()

    q = _normalize(
        question
    )

    numeric_columns = _numeric_columns(
        data
    )

    categorical_columns = _categorical_columns(
        data
    )

    if not numeric_columns:
        return False

    # =====================================================
    # FIND METRIC
    # =====================================================

    metric_col = _find_metric_column(
        data,
        question
    )

    if metric_col is None:
        metric_col = numeric_columns[0]

    # =====================================================
    # FIND DIMENSION
    # =====================================================

    dimension_col = None

    if categorical_columns:

        # First try values explicitly mentioned
        # in the question.

        for column in categorical_columns:

            values = _mentioned_values(
                data,
                column,
                question
            )

            if len(values) >= 2:

                dimension_col = column

                break

        # Otherwise use normal dimension detection.

        if dimension_col is None:

            dimension_col = _find_dimension_column(
                data,
                question
            )

    # =====================================================
    # 1. DISTRIBUTION
    # =====================================================

    if _is_distribution_question(
        question
    ):

        if _show_histogram(
            data,
            question,
            metric_col
        ):

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # 2. RELATIONSHIP / CORRELATION
    # =====================================================

    if _is_relationship_question(
        question
    ):

        if _show_scatter(
            data,
            question,
            metric_col
        ):

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # 3. TIME / TREND
    # =====================================================

    if _is_time_question(
        question
    ):

        if _show_time_series(
            data,
            question,
            metric_col
        ):

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # 4. SHARE / PERCENTAGE
    # =====================================================

    if (
        _is_share_question(
            question
        )
        and dimension_col
        and metric_col
    ):

        if _show_share(
            data,
            question,
            dimension_col,
            metric_col
        ):

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # 5. CATEGORY COMPARISON
    # =====================================================

    if (
        _comparison_requested(
            question
        )
        and dimension_col
    ):

        if _show_generic_comparison(
            data,
            question,
            dimension_col,
            metric_col
        ):

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # 6. HIGHEST / LOWEST GROUP AVERAGE
    # =====================================================

    if (
        dimension_col
        and metric_col
        and _average_requested(
            question
        )
        and (
            _highest_requested(
                question
            )
            or _lowest_requested(
                question
            )
        )
    ):

        if _highest_requested(
            question
        ):

            if _show_highest_group_average(
                data,
                dimension_col,
                metric_col,
                question
            ):

                return True

    # =====================================================
    # 7. PERSON DETECTION
    # =====================================================

    person_col = _find_column(
        data,
        [
            "Employee",
            "Employee_Name",
            "Employee Name",
            "Name",
            "Person",
            "Staff",
            "Customer",
        ]
    )

    # =====================================================
    # 8. THRESHOLD
    # =====================================================

    if (
        person_col
        and metric_col
    ):

        if _show_threshold(
            data,
            question,
            person_col,
            metric_col
        ):

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # 9. HIGHEST PERSON
    # =====================================================

    if (
        person_col
        and metric_col
    ):

        if _show_top_employee(
            data,
            question,
            person_col,
            metric_col,
            descending=True
        ):

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # 10. LOWEST PERSON
    # =====================================================

    if (
        person_col
        and metric_col
    ):

        if _show_top_employee(
            data,
            question,
            person_col,
            metric_col,
            descending=False
        ):

            return True

    # =====================================================
    # 11. GROUPED AVERAGE
    # =====================================================

    if (
        dimension_col
        and metric_col
        and _average_requested(
            question
        )
    ):

        return _show_grouped(
            data,
            dimension_col,
            metric_col,
            "mean",
            f"Average {metric_col} by "
            f"{dimension_col}",
            question
        )

    # =====================================================
    # 12. GROUPED TOTAL
    # =====================================================

    if (
        dimension_col
        and metric_col
        and _total_requested(
            question
        )
    ):

        return _show_grouped(
            data,
            dimension_col,
            metric_col,
            "sum",
            f"Total {metric_col} by "
            f"{dimension_col}",
            question
        )

    # =====================================================
    # 13. GENERIC FALLBACK
    # =====================================================

    if _generic_visualization(
        data,
        question
    ):

        return True

    # =====================================================
    # NOTHING FOUND
    # =====================================================

    return False

import streamlit as st

import re

from dataset_profiler import profile_dataset
from question_parser import parse_question
from visual_analysis import generate_visual_analysis


# =========================================================

# =========================================================

st.set_page_config(
    page_title="AI Data Analyst",
    page_icon="📊",
    layout="wide"
)


# =========================================================
# SESSION STATE
# =========================================================

if "chat_history" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.chat_history = []


# =========================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# =========================================================

def split_questions(text):
    """Split multiple questions entered by the user."""

    if not text:
        return []

    text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").strip()

    questions = []

    parts = re.split(r"\?", text)

    for part in parts:

        part = part.strip()

        if not part:
            continue

        part = re.sub(
            r"^\s*\d+\s*[\.\)\-:]\s*",
            "",
            part
        ).strip()

        if part:
            questions.append(part + "?")

    # Handle multiple lines without question marks
    if len(questions) == 1:

        lines = [
            line.strip()
            for line in text.split("\n")
            if line.strip()
        ]

        if len(lines) > 1:

            questions = []

            for line in lines:

                line = re.sub(
                    r"^\s*\d+\s*[\.\)\-:]\s*",
                    "",
                    line
                ).strip()

                if line:

                    if not line.endswith("?"):
                        line += "?"

                    questions.append(line)

    return questions


def get_numeric_columns(df):
    return (
        df
        .select_dtypes(include="number")
        .columns
        .tolist()
    )


def get_categorical_columns(df):
    return (
        df
        .select_dtypes(
            include=["object", "category"]
        )
        .columns
        .tolist()
    )


def get_date_columns(df):

    date_columns = []

    for column in df.columns:

        if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(
            df[column]
        ):

            date_columns.append(column)

        elif df[column].dtype == "object":

            converted = pd.to_datetime(
                df[column],
                errors="coerce"
            )

            if converted.notna().mean() >= 0.70:

                date_columns.append(column)

    return date_columns


def safe_numeric_series(df, column):

    return (
        pd.to_numeric(
            df[column],
            errors="coerce"
        )
        .dropna()
    )


# =========================================================

st.title("📊 AI Data Analyst")

st.write(
    "Upload your data and explore it with AI-powered "
    "analysis, KPIs, visualizations and business insights."
)


# =========================================================

            )

    except Exception as e:

        )


    # =====================================================
    # GENERAL DASHBOARD
    # =====================================================

    st.divider()

    st.header(
        "📊 Business Dashboard"
    )

    st.caption(
        "These dashboard elements are generated automatically "

    )


    # =====================================================
    # KPI CARDS
    # =====================================================

    st.subheader(
        "🎯 Key Performance Indicators"
    )

    kpi_values = []


    # -----------------------------------------------------
    # Total rows

    kpi_values.append(

            )

        elif selected_aggregation == "Minimum":

                visual_df
                .groupby(selected_dimension)[selected_metric]
                .min()
                .sort_values(ascending=False)
            )

        else:

                visual_df
                .groupby(selected_dimension)[selected_metric]
                .count()
                .sort_values(ascending=False)
            )

        display_data = visual_data.head(20)


        if not display_data.empty:

            st.bar_chart(
                display_data,
                use_container_width=True
            )

        else:

            st.info(
                "No data available for this visualization."
            )


    # =====================================================
    # TREND ANALYSIS
    # =====================================================

    if (
        date_columns
        and numeric_columns
    ):

        st.write(
            "### 📅 Trend Analysis"
        )

        col1, col2 = st.columns(2)


        with col1:

            selected_date = st.selectbox(
                "Date column",
                date_columns,
                key="dashboard_date"
            )


        with col2:

            selected_trend_metric = st.selectbox(
                "Trend metric",
                numeric_columns,
                key="dashboard_trend_metric"
            )


        trend_df = df.copy()


        trend_df[selected_date] = pd.to_datetime(
            trend_df[selected_date],
            errors="coerce"
        )


        trend_df[selected_trend_metric] = pd.to_numeric(
            trend_df[selected_trend_metric],
            errors="coerce"
        )


        trend_df = trend_df.dropna(
            subset=[
                selected_date,
                selected_trend_metric
            ]
        )


        if not trend_df.empty:

            trend_data = (
                trend_df
                .groupby(selected_date)[selected_trend_metric]
                .sum()
                .sort_index()
            )

            st.line_chart(
                trend_data,
                use_container_width=True
            )

        else:

            st.info(
                "No valid date data was found."
            )


    # =====================================================
    # OUTLIER DETECTION
    # =====================================================

    if numeric_columns:

        st.write(
            "### 🚨 Outlier Detection"
        )

        outlier_metric = st.selectbox(
            "Select metric for outlier detection",
            numeric_columns,
            key="outlier_metric"
        )


        outlier_series = safe_numeric_series(
            df,
            outlier_metric
        )


        if len(outlier_series) >= 4:

            q1 = outlier_series.quantile(0.25)

            q3 = outlier_series.quantile(0.75)

            iqr = q3 - q1

            lower_bound = q1 - 1.5 * iqr

            upper_bound = q3 + 1.5 * iqr

            outliers = outlier_series[
                (
                    outlier_series < lower_bound
                )
                |
                (
                    outlier_series > upper_bound
                )
            ]


            outlier_col1, outlier_col2, outlier_col3 = (
                st.columns(3)
            )


            with outlier_col1:

                st.metric(
                    "Outliers",
                    f"{len(outliers):,}"
                )


            with outlier_col2:

                st.metric(
                    "Lower Bound",
                    f"{lower_bound:,.2f}"
                )


            with outlier_col3:

                st.metric(
                    "Upper Bound",
                    f"{upper_bound:,.2f}"
                )


            if not outliers.empty:

                st.dataframe(
                    outliers.to_frame(
                        name=outlier_metric
                    ).head(20),
                    use_container_width=True
                )

            else:

                st.success(
                    "No statistical outliers were detected."
                )


    # =====================================================
    # CORRELATION ANALYSIS
    # =====================================================

    if len(numeric_columns) >= 2:

        st.write(
            "### 🔗 Correlation Analysis"
        )

        correlation_matrix = (
            df[numeric_columns]
            .corr()
        )


        st.dataframe(
            correlation_matrix.round(2),
            use_container_width=True
        )


        # Find strongest pair

        correlation_pairs = []

        for i in range(
            len(correlation_matrix.columns)
        ):

            for j in range(
                i + 1,
                len(correlation_matrix.columns)
            ):

                column_a = (
                    correlation_matrix.columns[i]
                )

                column_b = (
                    correlation_matrix.columns[j]
                )

                value = correlation_matrix.iloc[
                    i,
                    j
                ]


                if pd.notna(value):

                    correlation_pairs.append(
                        (
                            column_a,
                            column_b,
                            value
                        )
                    )


        if correlation_pairs:

            strongest_pair = max(
                correlation_pairs,
                key=lambda x: abs(x[2])
            )


            st.info(
                f"Strongest observed correlation: "
                f"{strongest_pair[0]} and "
                f"{strongest_pair[1]} "
                f"({strongest_pair[2]:.2f})"
            )


    # =====================================================
    # NUMERIC METRICS OVERVIEW
    # =====================================================

    if numeric_columns:

        st.write(
            "### 📌 Numeric Metrics Overview"
        )

        metric_data = []


        for column in numeric_columns:

            series = safe_numeric_series(
                df,
                column
            )


            if not series.empty:

                metric_data.append(
                    {
                        "Metric": column,
                        "Total": series.sum(),
                        "Average": series.mean(),
                        "Maximum": series.max(),
                        "Minimum": series.min()
                    }
                )


        if metric_data:

            metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(
                metric_data
            )

            st.dataframe(
                metrics_df,
                use_container_width=True,
                hide_index=True
            )


    # =====================================================
    # AI BUSINESS INSIGHTS
    # =====================================================

    st.divider()

    st.subheader(
        "🤖 AI Business Insights"
    )


    if st.button(
        "Generate AI Insights",
        key="generate_ai_insights"
    ):

        total_sales = (
            df["Sales"].sum()
            if "Sales" in df.columns
            else None
        )


        total_quantity = (
            df["Quantity"].sum()
            if "Quantity" in df.columns
            else None
        )


        # -------------------------------------------------
        # TOP PRODUCT
        # -------------------------------------------------

        top_product = None
        top_product_sales = None


        if (
            "Product" in df.columns
            and "Sales" in df.columns
        ):

            product_sales = (
                df
                .groupby("Product")["Sales"]
                .sum()
                .sort_values(ascending=False)
            )


            if not product_sales.empty:

                top_product = product_sales.index[0]

                top_product_sales = (
                    product_sales.iloc[0]
                )


        # -------------------------------------------------
        # TOP REGION
        # -------------------------------------------------

        top_region = None
        top_region_sales = None


        if (
            "Region" in df.columns
            and "Sales" in df.columns
        ):

            region_sales = (
                df
                .groupby("Region")["Sales"]
                .sum()
                .sort_values(ascending=False)
            )


            if not region_sales.empty:

                top_region = region_sales.index[0]

                top_region_sales = (
                    region_sales.iloc[0]
                )


        # -------------------------------------------------
        # SEGMENT SALES
        # -------------------------------------------------

        segment_sales = {}


        if (
            "Customer_Segment" in df.columns
            and "Sales" in df.columns
        ):

            segment_sales = (
                df
                .groupby(
                    "Customer_Segment"
                )["Sales"]
                .sum()
                .sort_values(
                    ascending=False
                )
                .to_dict()
            )


        # -------------------------------------------------
        # OLLAMA PROMPT
        # -------------------------------------------------

        prompt = f"""
You are a professional business analyst.

Use ONLY the verified facts provided below.

VERIFIED DATA:

Total Sales:
{total_sales}

Total Quantity Sold:
{total_quantity}

Top Product:
{top_product}

Top Product Sales:
{top_product_sales}

Top Region:
{top_region}

Top Region Sales:
{top_region_sales}

Sales by Customer Segment:
{segment_sales}

STRICT RULES:

1. Do not invent statistics.
2. Do not claim sales increased or decreased unless
   a comparison is provided.
3. Do not introduce numbers that are not provided.
4. Do not assume causes that cannot be proven.
5. Clearly distinguish observations from recommendations.
6. Do not mention Python, prompts, or internal instructions.
7. Keep the answer concise and professional.

Return exactly these sections:

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

KEY INSIGHTS

STRONGEST PERFORMERS

AREAS TO WATCH

RECOMMENDATIONS

Use bullet points.
"""


        # -------------------------------------------------
        # CALL OLLAMA
        # -------------------------------------------------

        try:

            with st.spinner(
                "🤖 Llama 3 is analyzing the data..."
            ):

                response = requests.post(
                    "http://localhost:11434/api/generate",

                    json={
                        "model": "llama3",
                        "prompt": prompt,
                        "stream": False
                    },

                    timeout=120
                )


            if response.status_code == 200:

                ai_response = (
                    response
                    .json()
                    .get("response", "")
                    .strip()
                )


                if ai_response:

                    st.markdown(
                        ai_response
                    )

                else:

                    st.warning(
                        "Ollama returned an empty response."
                    )

            else:

                st.error(
                    "Could not connect to Ollama."
                )

                st.code(
                    response.text
                )


        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:

            st.error(
                f"Ollama connection error: {e}"
            )


    # =====================================================
    # ASK YOUR DATA
    # =====================================================

    st.divider()

    st.header(
        "💬 Ask Your Data"
    )

    st.write(
        "Ask specific questions about your uploaded dataset. "
        "The application will calculate the answer and "
        "generate a visualization when appropriate."
    )


    # =====================================================

    # =====================================================

    with st.form(

                "Which department has the highest average salary?\n"

        ask_button

        user_question = user_question.strip()


        # =================================================

                verified_results.append(
                    {

        # =================================================

            for index, item in enumerate(

                st.markdown(
                    f"### Question {index}"

                st.write(

                st.write(
                    "Intent:"

                try:

USER QUESTION:

{item["verified"]}

14. If a verified calculation contains a Total,

15. If a verified calculation contains a difference,

16. If a verified calculation contains a list of

17. Keep answers concise and professional.
18. Do not mention Python.
19. Do not mention the analysis engine.
20. Do not mention prompts or internal instructions.
21. Do not say information is missing if it is present.

VERIFIED CALCULATIONS:

{verified_context}

RESPONSE FORMAT:

Question 1:
<short direct answer>

Question 2:
<short direct answer>

Question 3:
<short direct answer>

Continue until ALL questions are answered.

Return ONLY the answers.
"""


        # =================================================
        # CALL OLLAMA
        # =================================================

        try:

            with st.spinner(
                "🤖 Analyzing your questions..."
            ):

                response = requests.post(
                    "http://localhost:11434/api/generate",

                    json={
                        "model": "llama3",
                        "prompt": prompt,
                        "stream": False
                    },

                    timeout=120
                )


            # =================================================
            # SUCCESS
            # =================================================

            if response.status_code == 200:

                answer = (
                    response
                    .json()
                    .get("response", "")
                    .strip()
                )


                if not answer:

                    st.warning(
                        "Ollama returned an empty answer."

                else:

                    # -----------------------------------------

                    st.session_state.chat_history.append(

                    # -----------------------------------------

                st.code(
                    response.text

        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:

            st.error(
                f"Ollama connection error: {e}"
            )


        # =================================================
        # QUESTION-SPECIFIC VISUALIZATION
        # =================================================

        st.markdown(
            "### 📊 Automatic Visualization"
        )


        visualization_created = False


        for index, question in enumerate(

            st.markdown(

                if visual_created:

                    "No automatic visualization "

                )


        if not visualization_created:

                "The question-specific visualization engine "

import re


def parse_question(question):
    """
    Identify the user's intent.

    Returns:
        aggregation
        ranking
        limit
        comparison
        metric_hint
    """

    question = question.lower().strip()


    # =========================================================
    # AGGREGATION
    # =========================================================

    aggregation = None

    if (
        "average" in question
        or "mean" in question
        or "avg" in question
    ):
        aggregation = "mean"

    elif (
        "total" in question
        or "sum" in question
    ):
        aggregation = "sum"


    # =========================================================
    # RANKING
    # =========================================================

    ranking = None

    if (
        "highest" in question
        or "top" in question
        or "most" in question
        or "best" in question
        or "maximum" in question
        or "max" in question
    ):
        ranking = "highest"

    elif (
        "lowest" in question
        or "least" in question
        or "worst" in question
        or "smallest" in question
        or "minimum" in question
        or "min" in question
    ):
        ranking = "lowest"


    # =========================================================
    # TOP N
    # =========================================================

    limit = None

    match = re.search(
        r"\btop\s+(\d+)",
        question
    )

    if match:
        limit = int(match.group(1))


    # =========================================================
    # COMPARISON
    # =========================================================

    comparison = False

    comparison_words = [
        "compare",
        "comparison",
        "versus",
        "vs",
        "difference",
        "higher than",
        "lower than",
        "more than",
        "less than",
        "better than",
        "worse than"
    ]

    for word in comparison_words:

        if word in question:
            comparison = True
            break


    # =========================================================
    # METRIC HINT
    # =========================================================

    metric_hint = None


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Salary
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    salary_words = [
        "salary",
        "salaries",
        "pay",
        "paid",
        "pays",
        "paying",
        "wage",
        "wages",
        "compensation",
        "earnings"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in salary_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "salary"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Performance
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    performance_words = [
        "performance",
        "performance score",
        "performing",
        "best performing",
        "worst performing",
        "rating",
        "ratings",
        "score",
        "scores"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in performance_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "performance"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Experience
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    experience_words = [
        "experience",
        "experienced",
        "years",
        "tenure"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in experience_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "experience"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Sales / Revenue
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    sales_words = [
        "sales",
        "sale",
        "revenue",
        "turnover",
        "income"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in sales_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "sales"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Profit
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    profit_words = [
        "profit",
        "profits",
        "profitability",
        "earnings"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in profit_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "profit"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Quantity
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    quantity_words = [
        "quantity",
        "quantities",
        "units",
        "unit",
        "volume"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in quantity_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "quantity"


    # =========================================================
    # NATURAL-LANGUAGE DEFAULTS
    # =========================================================

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # "pays the most"
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "pays the most" in question
        or "pay the most" in question
        or "pays the highest" in question
        or "pay the highest" in question
        or "pays better" in question
        or "pays more" in question
    ):
        metric_hint = "salary"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # "best performing"
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "best performing" in question
        or "highest performing" in question
        or "performs best" in question
        or "perform best" in question
    ):
        metric_hint = "performance"
        ranking = "highest"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # "worst performing"
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "worst performing" in question
        or "lowest performing" in question
        or "performs worst" in question
        or "perform worst" in question
    ):
        metric_hint = "performance"
        ranking = "lowest"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # "most experienced"
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "most experienced" in question
        or "highest experience" in question
        or "more experienced" in question
    ):
        metric_hint = "experience"
        ranking = "highest"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # "least experienced"
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "least experienced" in question
        or "lowest experience" in question
        or "less experienced" in question
    ):
        metric_hint = "experience"
        ranking = "lowest"


    # =========================================================
    # RETURN INTENT
    # =========================================================

    return {
        "aggregation": aggregation,
        "ranking": ranking,
        "limit": limit,
        "comparison": comparison,
        "metric_hint": metric_hint
    }

import re


def parse_question(question):
    """
    Identify the user's intent.

    Returns:
        aggregation
        ranking
        limit
        comparison
        metric_hint
    """

    question = question.lower().strip()


    # =========================================================
    # AGGREGATION
    # =========================================================

    aggregation = None

    if (
        "average" in question
        or "mean" in question
        or "avg" in question
    ):
        aggregation = "mean"

    elif (
        "total" in question
        or "sum" in question
    ):
        aggregation = "sum"


    # =========================================================
    # RANKING
    # =========================================================

    ranking = None

    if (
        "highest" in question
        or "top" in question
        or "most" in question
        or "best" in question
        or "maximum" in question
        or "max" in question
    ):
        ranking = "highest"

    elif (
        "lowest" in question
        or "least" in question
        or "worst" in question
        or "smallest" in question
        or "minimum" in question
        or "min" in question
    ):
        ranking = "lowest"


    # =========================================================
    # TOP N
    # =========================================================

    limit = None

    match = re.search(
        r"\btop\s+(\d+)",
        question
    )

    if match:
        limit = int(match.group(1))


    # =========================================================
    # COMPARISON
    # =========================================================

    comparison = False

    comparison_words = [
        "compare",
        "comparison",
        "versus",
        "vs",
        "difference",
        "higher than",
        "lower than",
        "more than",
        "less than",
        "better than",
        "worse than"
    ]

    for word in comparison_words:

        if word in question:
            comparison = True
            break


    # =========================================================
    # METRIC HINT
    # =========================================================

    metric_hint = None


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Salary
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    salary_words = [
        "salary",
        "salaries",
        "pay",
        "paid",
        "pays",
        "paying",
        "wage",
        "wages",
        "compensation",
        "earnings"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in salary_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "salary"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Performance
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    performance_words = [
        "performance",
        "performance score",
        "performing",
        "best performing",
        "worst performing",
        "rating",
        "ratings",
        "score",
        "scores"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in performance_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "performance"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Experience
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    experience_words = [
        "experience",
        "experienced",
        "years",
        "tenure"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question

    ):
        metric_hint = "experience"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Sales / Revenue
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    sales_words = [
        "sales",
        "sale",
        "revenue",
        "turnover",
        "income"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in sales_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "sales"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    profit_words = [
        "profit",

    ]

    if any(

    # ---------------------------------------------------------

        "quantity",
        "quantities",
        "units",
        "unit",
        "volume"
    ]

    if any(
        word in question
        for word in quantity_words
    ):
        metric_hint = "quantity"


    # =========================================================
    # NATURAL-LANGUAGE DEFAULTS
    # =========================================================

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # "pays the most"
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "pays the most" in question
        or "pay the most" in question
        or "pays the highest" in question
        or "pay the highest" in question
        or "pays better" in question
        or "pays more" in question
    ):

    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    # ---------------------------------------------------------

        "best performing" in question
        or "highest performing" in question
        or "performs best" in question
        or "perform best" in question

        ranking = "highest"


    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (

        or "lowest performing" in question
        or "performs worst" in question
